[[Retake Workshop]] |terminal = |cell name =BeckleyWorkshopExt |edid =LocMTRBeckleyWorkshopLocation |refid ={{ID|00264E04}} |crafting ={{Crafting stations FO76 |workshop =yes }} |budget =1500 |keywords =* {{Location keyword FO76|LocTypeWorkshop}} * {{Location keyword FO76|LocTypeWorkshopPublic}} * {{Location keyword FO76|LocTypeFastTravelDestination}} * {{Location keyword FO76|LocThemeWorkingClass}} * {{Location keyword FO76|LocLootScaleSmall}} * {{Location keyword FO76|LocTypeClearable}} * {{Location keyword FO76|LocRegionMTR}} * {{Location keyword FO76|LocEncSupportGiant}} * {{Location keyword FO76|LocEncSupportLarge}} }} The '''Beckley Coal Mine Exhibit''', or just '''Beckley mine exhibit''', is a [[Fallout 76 locations|location]] in the town of [[Beckley]] in the [[Ash Heap]] region of [[Appalachia]]. It is a [[Workshop (Fallout 76)|public workshop]] with [[Claim Workshop|claim]], [[Defend Workshop|defend]], and [[Retake Workshop|retake]] [[Fallout 76 quests|events]]. ==Background== The Beckley mine exhibit is a model mine preserved at the edge of Beckley, including a replica of the [[Miners Monument]]. ==Layout== The Beckley mine exhibit is a raised park area surrounded by a chain-link fence. The workshop area is roughly square, bordered by the road in the east and the edge of the mountain to the west. Three [[Oil (Fallout 76)|oil]], a [[Gold (Fallout 76)|gold]], and a [[Crystal (Fallout 76)|crystal]] [[resource deposits|resource deposit]] are present and can be mined with a [[mineral extractor]]. Six food and eight water resources are also available. There are multiple park pavilions and a small, wooden playground can be found to the northeast with a chance of a [[Caps stash (Fallout 76)|caps stash]] in the middle of it. At the center of the park is a large copper statue surrounded by benches. To the west is a blocked-off abandoned mine entrance. A large wooden structure is on the hill above the entrance, but cannot be climbed. To the southeast, a small, gutted museum that serves as an information center and gift shop for the exhibit can be found, though only the first floor can be accessed. A locked safe ([[Picklock]] 2) is on the wall behind the counter in the building. There is a supply closet with a few [[Fallout 76 junk items|junk items]] behind a locked wooden door (Picklock 0). It is typically inhabited by [[Robobrain (Fallout 76)|Robobrains]] and [[Protectron (Fallout 76)|Protectrons]]. ==Notable loot== * [[Top of the World ad packet]] - Holotape, inside the gift shop, on the front counter by the register. ==Appearances== The Beckley mine exhibit appears {{In|FO76}}. ==Behind the scenes== The Beckley mine exhibit is based on the real-world [[wikipedia:Phillips-Sprague Mine|Beckley Exhibition Coal Mine]], formerly known as Phillips-Sprague Mine. Lead artist [[Nathan Purkeypile]] went on the mine's tour while scouting out West Virginia for the game, and took "hundreds of pictures." The sign at the in-game location is also based on a real-world sign for the Beckley Exhibition Coal Mine.[https://archive.is/5SGPQ Nate Purkeypile on Twitter]: ''"Another fun one. We went on this on the research trip for 76. It was amazing.
